ldap_server.description: URI of the LDAP server (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com or ldaps://ldap.example.com for LDAPS).

ldap_base_dn.description: Base Distinguished Name (DN) for LDAP user searches.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN to bind as when searching the LDAP directory. Leave blank for anonymous bind.

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the bind DN. Only required if bind DN is set.

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP search filter used to find users. Use %u for the provided username.

ldap_uid_attribute.description: LDAP attribute containing the numeric user ID (UID).

ldap_gid_attribute.description: LDAP attribute containing the numeric group ID (GID).

ldap_home_attribute.description: LDAP attribute containing the user's home directory path.

ldap_shell_attribute.description: LDAP attribute containing the user's default shell (optional).

ldap_password_attribute.description: LDAP attribute containing the user's password hash (used for authentication).

ldap_use_tls.description: Enable startTLS to encrypt the LDAP connection (requires startTLS-capable server).

ldap_ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for verifying LDAP server certificate (used with TLS).

ldap_client_cert_file.description: Path to client certificate file for mutual TLS (optional).

ldap_client_key_file.description: Path to client private key file for mutual TLS (optional).

ldap_version.description: LDAP protocol version (2 or 3). Version 3 is strongly recommended.

ldap_require_cert.description: Certificate verification mode for TLS: 'never', 'allow', 'try', or 'demand' (default).

ldap_max_conn.description: Maximum number of LDAP connections to pool for performance.

ldap_debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog (0 = off, 1 = on).

ldap_additional_search_bases.description: Additional LDAP base DNs to search (e.g., for users in multiple OUs). Each entry is added as a separate LDAPSearchBase directive.

items.description: LDAP base DN to search in addition to the main base DN.
